title: REPORT on the control of the financial activities of the European Investment Bank – annual report 2023
part_text: 18. Acknowledges the EIB Group’s increased role in supporting the EU’s defence and security policy and dual-use technologies by providing funding and leveraging private investment to enhance the Union’s strategic autonomy and resilience; stresses the importance of the EIB’s investment capabilities, supporting initiatives that contribute to strengthening the EU’s defence industry, advancing cybersecurity infrastructure and promoting innovation in critical defence technologies;
